title: Conditions on an algebraic space over a field in terms of its closed points

standard_prerequisites.name: Closed points of schemes over fields

core_obligations: Reduce to the presentation U -> Spec(k); closed points of U are dense in every nonempty closed subset.
Apply the pointwise conditions at every closed point; the conditions are open conditions on |X|.
Conclude the space-level equivalences from the point-level ones via density of closed points.
proof_roadmap: Presentation reduction; pointwise conditions; density finish.
difficulty_reason: A point-to-space lift; the density argument is the substance.
